decision: ENDORSE bounded current shared-array exact-assay SHELVE; broader human functional IG/CGI and independently authenticated regional EMC measurements remain pending. No material blocker in this review scope.

primary_source_findings.check: Original primary text separately names two human IG pyrosequencing assays approximately14kb upstream of MEG3. TableS5 binary Word strings place the exact mapped F/R sequences in distinct IG-DMR(1)/(2) rows. Both source assays interrogate five CpGs; the full PCR envelope is not the exact five-site output or entire functional DMR boundary.
primary_source_findings.scope: Human HCC/adjacent-liver primary assay prior art; no native EMC data. Published allele-expression experiments cannot be transferred to an EMC array beta.

primary_source_findings.check: Original methods explicitly describe two PCR rounds and TableS2 separates first/second F/R and universal-biotin tail. IG1 outer pair maps locally. IG2 outerF maps, outerR does not; innerR maps while authenticated innerF genomic placement remains unresolved. No outerF/innerR hybrid interval may be accepted.
primary_source_findings.IG2_status: Incomplete source-supported mapping; broader functional assay/context pending, not a zero-region or biological negative.
primary_source_findings.scope: Human osteosarcoma/normal-bone context and separate mouse experiments; neither defines an EMC condition or justifies mouse-human boundary transfer.

primary_source_findings.check: Primary methods name fourteen-q MEG3/DLK1:IG-DMR among seven imprinted loci measured by ASMM RTQ-PCR. Exact SD5 workbook row/next row identify F/R separately from methylated/unmethylated probe sequences. All four sequences were distinguished; only F/R define the candidate envelope.
primary_source_findings.scope: Human reprogrammed iPSC/culture-history prior art, not a native tumor control. Methylated/unmethylated assay signals do not identify parental allele without separate linkage; an array beta does not reproduce that probe-PCR endpoint.

assay_and_annotation_findings.independent_mapping: Expanded IUPAC sequence variants independently, normalized C-to-T or G-to-A conversions and searched both orientations including overlapping matches. Reproduced every source primer placement and candidate envelope. Uniqueness is local to the official retained75kb hg38 chr14 segment, not whole-genome specificity or a validated PCR design.
assay_and_annotation_findings.array_zero_scope: All four complete candidate PCR envelopes contain zero CpG probes in the complete HM450 and EPIC annotations. No beta matrix was loaded. This supports failure of those exact candidate assays; it cannot establish absence of probes throughout the biological IG-DMR/CGI, absence of methylation, impossibility of another assay or absence of a useful EMC state.
assay_and_annotation_findings.row_alignment: Retained official InfiniumAnnotation index explicitly defines coherent files as row-aligned to manufacturer ordering and CpG_beg as0-based. Independent streaming checked equal ordering/coordinate row lengths and unique probe IDs at both platforms; no chromosome/assembly offset or coordinate widening was used.
assay_and_annotation_findings.nearby_favorable_pending_evidence: EPIC cg27281850 at100810948/mapQ15 and cg06442344 at100810966/mapQ11 are outside the complete HCCIG2 envelope. Mapping quality is reported, not accepted as genome-wide specificity, SNP/cross-reactivity masking or functional-region validation. Their possible broader CGI applicability remains pending rather than being dismissed or silently accepted.
assay_and_annotation_findings.original_coordinate_precision: Additive amendment03 correctly notes mainTable1IG100345582 agrees with rounded Table3 start/end midpoint100345581.5, while Table3 printed midpoint and TableS1 printed boundaries are discordant. Original freeze remains preserved; this later review does not repeat the first gate's independent review.

coverage_and_value.all10_scope: All ten reference EMC rows remain explicit: nine HM450 and one EPIC, primary FFPE, no newly pooled donor count. Existing identity metadata is reused; this review independently verifies the coverage/platform inventory and shared annotation applicability, not original specimen histology.
coverage_and_value.controls: All62 fixed potential primary-FFPE control records remain inventory, not an evaluated numerical or matched causal comparison. Source/slide/purity/site/lineage and independent replication are unresolved for a new regional-state interpretation.
coverage_and_value.Case21: Published Case21 identity/age/mitotic annotations are reused. GSE279837-to-manuscript specimen binding and reference-cohort biological overlap remain limited; GSE243075 is unrelated. One reference EPIC plus Case21 is not a new replicated all10 assay cohort.
coverage_and_value.validity: The limited source and exact-envelope coverage statements reproduce. Current shared joint IG-plus-somatic-DMR route is not supported by these assays. Complete broader functional boundaries, appropriate measurement quality, source binding and all eligible EMC conditions remain unresolved.
coverage_and_value.scientific_value: A nearby low-mapQ EPIC pair in at most a narrow source subset, or a technically computable general DNAm score, would not by itself guide a distinct useful native-EMC regulatory measurement beyond published other-sarcoma regional states or diagnostic classes. Lack of ages alone is not the defeat. Potential value could return with a primary-supported regional assay, independently replicated native cases and a prospectively discriminating lineage/mixture/batch comparison.
coverage_and_value.no_inference: No allelic imprinting, miRNA expression, regulatory causality, therapeutic effect, negative EMC methylation or exhausted-search claim.

reopening: Authenticate a primary human functional regional measurement and probe specificity/quality, all relevant EMC specimen/condition/donor linkage and appropriate independent native comparators. Freeze one useful discrimination before disease values, obtain lead-approved finite stage if needed, and preserve broader pending routes without enlarging boundaries to obtain favorable measurements.
limits: One bounded retained-source/annotation batch. No duplicate source retrieval, matrix values, rendering, full-paper review, whole-public evidence census or claim that all pending evidence has been assessed. Published non-EMC source context was read only for assay definitions, not quantitatively reanalysed or transferred to EMC. Original metadata authentication/older assays reused with exact bindings.
